denominator_definition: Valid positive baseline transferable rows on prior dated Stockholm ordinary-share roster, excluding target issuer, same industry, and fixed peer indexevent exclusions. No global fund NAV denominator. Foreign-incorporated Stockholm-listed ordinary shares remain part of Swedish-market portfolios.
outside_universe_caution: Outside-verified-ordinary rows may include foreign listings, bonds or other securities; they are NOT denominator capital. The data screen does not relabel them all foreign.
scope: Original ownership-family label includes mixed benchmark mandates. Current simple-family design is narrower and target-specific. This baseline audit does not estimate change in ownership.
repeat_caution: Fund-role records overlap heavily; their sums and quantiles are coverage diagnostics only, not independent observations.
